caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 162 of 2003
lawyer:
Md Roushan Ali, Advocate instructed by Md Ataul Haque Advocate-on-Record ------ For the Petitioner. 
Not represented ------ The Respondents.
parties:
Sultan Miah (Md) ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Kazi Abu Siddique and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 7. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, we are of the view that the High Court Division committed no error of law in affirming the judgment and decree of the trial Court and the appellate judgment has been rightly set aside as the same is tainted with error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. For all the above reasons, we find no cogent ground for our interference with the impugned judgment of the High Court Division. Mr Roushan Ali, the learned Advocate, could not pinpoint any illegality or legal infirmity in the impugned. judgment of the High Court Division causing failure of justice in making the Rule absolute. Therefore, this petition merits no consideration.
